• The word **"Conffess"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Confess**". (स्वीकार करना)
 
• **"Confess"** means to admit or state that one has committed a crime or is at fault in some way. (स्वीकार करना)
 
 
• ​​Example: She decided to confess her mistake to her parents.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chivalrous** (साहसी): Courteous and gallant, especially towards women.

 
 
• **Example:** The **chivalrous **knight helped the lady cross the street.
 
 
 
• **Expose** (प्रकट करना): To make something visible by uncovering it.
 
 
• **Example: **The journalist worked to **expose **the corruption in the government.
 
 
 
• **Convict** (अपराधी): To declare someone to be guilty of a criminal offense.
 
 
• **Example:** The court will **convict **the accused if proven guilty.
